title: Start Here: how an agent journey becomes a world

audio.production: ElevenLabs voice through the Rote adapter; licensed music mixed beneath narration

cues.text: Our example is simple: create a page in Notion and verify it. The gate fixes that destination before any tool or route is chosen.
The fork asks which route fits: Notion MCP through CALL, notion-cli through SHELL, or the Notion site through DRIVE. This tutorial deliberately uses all three so their roles stay distinct.
The station equips the Notion adapter before using it. CALL means a typed adapter or API capability; the station is the system, while the floating bead in front is its initialization event.
The bars mean required authority. Notion workspace access must be satisfied before the adapter can create the page; this authorization bead still belongs to the CALL capability.

The worksite retrieves the target Notion database through CALL. The adapter is already equipped; this bead is one event performed through it. Its volume shows tokens and its separate halo shows latency.
The first page-creation attempt fails because the parent database is not shared. The barricade keeps that failed operation and its evidence visible instead of hiding it behind a retry.
After access is corrected, CALL retries page creation. The bridge preserves the relationship between the blocker and the operation that returned the Notion route to progress.
A second station equips notion-cli through SHELL. It is a separate capability instance, initialized before its validation operation is interpreted as work.
notion-cli validates the prepared page content. The chamber groups supporting work; its floating event bead remains local evidence at this vantage rather than becoming another global landmark.
A third station equips a leased browser session through DRIVE. The browser is used to see the created Notion page as a person would encounter it.

DRIVE opens the new Notion page and reads its stored browser evidence. Two event beads share this vantage: their spacing is time, volume is tokens, halo sweep is latency, and depth would show true overlap.
The verified Notion page becomes a durable result the user can keep. The same example has now connected intent, decision, three modalities, operations, failure, recovery, evidence, and artifact.
